name: Himal Trekker 20000mAh Power Bank with 67W Turbo Output, in-built USB-C cable, digital display and triple output ports
highlights: Charge laptop, phone and tablet at the same time
Recharges fully in about 2.5 hours with a compatible 67W charger
Built-in USB-C cable doubles as a carry lanyard
description: A 20000mAh power bank designed for long Himalayan road trips: 67W turbo output via PD 3.0 / PPS, 12-layer cell protection, a digital charge display and three simultaneous output ports so a laptop, phone and earbuds can charge together. Demo listing — figures are seller-provided and not independently verified.
warranty: 1 year brand warranty from the date of purchase (demo listing — terms shown are seller-provided).

faq.q: How many devices can charge simultaneously?
faq.a: Three — two USB-A ports plus one USB-C port can output at the same time, within the 67W total budget.

faq.q: Is this compatible with my MacBook?
faq.a: It supports USB-C PD output up to 67W, which covers most USB-C laptops including MacBooks that charge over USB-C. Check your laptop's required wattage.

faq.q: Can it charge while it is recharging?
faq.a: Pass-through charging is supported, but total output is limited while the power bank itself is recharging.
